title: Crossing the Cyber Divide: Sim-to-Sim and Sim-to-Real Transfer for RL Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.00759v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cyber attack agents are typically trained and evaluated within a single simulator, making it unclear whether learned policies transfer beyond the environments in which they were developed. This limitation hinders both deployment and fair comparison, as cyber simulators differ substantially in their state representations, observation models, and action spaces. In this paper, we study policy transfer across cyber environments and argue that simulator-to-simulator and simulator-to-real transfer can be viewed as instances of the same underlying alignment problem. We propose a framework that separates state alignment from action translation, enabling a policy trained in one environment to operate in another without retraining. We evaluate transfer across four cyber platforms, CyberBattleSim, NetSecGame, CyberWheel, and NASim, including emulated deployments in NASim. Our experiments show that zero-shot transfer is feasible, fully preserving

translated_title: 跨越网络鸿沟：强化学习智能体的仿真器间迁移与仿真到现实的迁移
translated_abstract: 网络攻击智能体通常在单一仿真器内进行训练和评估，这使得所学策略能否迁移到其开发环境之外变得不明确。这一局限既阻碍了实际部署，也阻碍了公平比较，因为各种网络仿真器在状态表示、观测模型和动作空间方面存在显著差异。本文研究了跨网络环境的策略迁移，并论证仿真器到仿真器以及仿真器到现实的迁移可以被视为同一底层对齐问题的不同实例。我们提出了一个将状态对齐与动作转换相分离的框架，使在一个环境中训练的策略无需重新训练即可在另一个环境中运行。我们在四个网络平台上评估了迁移效果——CyberBattleSim、NetSecGame、CyberWheel 和 NASim，其中包括在 NASim 中的模拟部署。我们的实验表明零样本迁移是可行的，并且完整地保留了……（摘要原文在此截断）
tldr: 提出了一个将状态对齐与动作转换相分离的框架，使强化学习网络攻击智能体无需重新训练即可在四个不同的网络仿真平台之间以及从仿真到现实环境实现零样本策略迁移。
en_tdlr: Proposes a framework that separates state alignment from action translation, enabling zero-shot transfer of RL cyber attack agents across four different cyber simulation platforms and from simulation to real environments without retraining.
